epistemic_boundary: Closure is for the ProgBase 4.2.0.6 AutoCal subsystem and its reachable semantic graph, not the entire ProgBase executable.

For Reset Petrol, Reset Gas and Manual AutoMatch, the canonical EXE proves the host contract/frame and post-action refresh, but the supplied Portmon captures do not observe those commands; firmware-internal selective mutation is therefore not fabricated.
Reset All 0x04 is observed in both canonical Portmon captures; LOGNOVO proves a broad AutoCal-state reset in the captured firmware/session.
The 12000-function native catalog and 2500-decompile caps are diagnostic discovery ceilings; closure is based on all semantically admitted AutoCal targets/dependencies, all of which are closed.
